newsitem.title: USA: Bonded Motors stake cut by investor.
newsitem.headline: Bonded Motors stake cut by investor.

text.p: New York investor James Haber said Thursday he cut his stake in Bonded Motors Inc to 146,000 common shares or 4.8 percent from seven percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Haber said his latest transactions include a net of 110,800 common sold between October 31 and December 9 at prices ranging from $7.21 to $10.107 per share.
Haber said he holds the balance of his stake for investment purposes.
